messages:
alex k: FYI escalation from AcmeCo — they say model output included customer emails that were in their prompt. Request ID req_abc123. Need repro steps + sanitized debug bundle before we loop in eng/security.
maria p: Can we get a debug bundle + a curl repro? Customer says prompt contains emails & order IDs, so they don't want raw text shared. We need exact headers, request-id, timestamp, and a sanitized prompt sample.
alex k: Uploaded a debug bundle to the private support bucket: gs://redwood-debug/acmeco/req_abc123/bundle.tar.gz (internal-only). It contains full prompt and request logs. I put the request id and a short curl repro below — prompt is masked here.
alex k: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-1","input":"<REDACTED_PROMPT:contains-emails-and-orderids>","request_id":"req_abc123"}'
```
sam r: Instead of sharing raw bundle, run our scrubber to produce a sanitized bundle we can share with eng: 
```
debug-bundle-scrub \
  --input bundle.tar.gz \
  --output bundle.sanitized.tar.gz \
  --redact-regex "\\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\\b" \
  --redact-phone "\\d{3}[- ]?\\d{3}[- ]?\\d{4}" \
  --redact-ssn "\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\b" \
  --preserve-request-ids
```
sam r: The scrubber preserves request ids, timestamps, headers; it replaces matched PII with tokens like <REDACTED_EMAIL_1> and outputs a mapping file encrypted in Vault.
security-ops: I can run the scrub and produce a sanitized bundle + encrypted redaction map. We won't share the map outside security. We need explicit customer consent to share the sanitized bundle with engineering — is that obtainable?
alex k: Customer verbally OK to share a sanitized bundle only. I'll capture written consent and paste it here in the ticket. For now, I won't share raw bundle.
maria p: Quick redaction checklist for the scrub:
- emails -> <REDACTED_EMAIL_n>
- phone numbers -> <REDACTED_PHONE_n>
- API keys / tokens -> <REDACTED_SECRET>
- internal client IDs (client_12345) -> <REDACTED_CLIENT_ID>
- full names -> <REDACTED_NAME>
- anything that looks like an account number / SSN -> <REDACTED_SSN>
Also: keep request ids, timestamps, status codes, and latency values unchanged.
alex k: Attaching tiny sanitized log excerpt for context (no PII):
```
[2025-10-11T14:22:10Z] req=req_abc123 status=200 latency=120ms prompt_excerpt="...<REDACTED_PROMPT>..."
[2025-10-11T14:22:11Z] req=req_abc123 trace=trace_zzz user_id=<REDACTED_CLIENT_ID>
```
security-ops: Uploaded sanitized bundle to secure bucket: gs://redwood-sanitized/acmeco/req_abc123/bundle.sanitized.tar.gz and stored the redaction map in the secrets vault. Link shared with @eng-oncall only. :lock:
eng-oncall: :eyes: Received the sanitized bundle and curl repro. I'll try to reproduce locally and check for header propagation issues or model prompt leakage in the runtime. ETA ~2h, will update INC-2025-987.
support-bot: Tagging thread with `pii-redaction`, created ticket INC-2025-987, and added watchers: security-ops, eng-oncall, support.
maria p: One more thing — when you produce the curl repro for eng, please replace large prompt substrings longer than 20 chars with <TRUNCATED_PROMPT> to avoid accidental leaks. Also include exact model version and runtime flags.
alex k: Got it. I'll run the scrubber, paste the consent statement from the customer, and upload the final sanitized curl + bundle. Will post here once done. :thumbsup:
